newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish troops chase rebel Kurds in northern Iraq.
- Washington says Hizbollah capable of carrying out operations inside the United States.
- Morocco, Egypt to announce a joint free trade zone.
- Moroccan king, Egyptian president discuss Jerusalem.
- Qatar Islamic Bank posts 50 million riyal net profit in 1996.
- Mecca governor opens a 65 million riyal jewellery plant in Jeddah.
